roku.title: Roku
roku.subtitle: Find the Roku boxes on this network and put the KROMA channel on them.
roku.noLanAddress: This server has no LAN address to hand a box.
roku.passwordHint: The password chosen on the box when developer mode was enabled. Every box you install on must use the same one.
roku.passwordKeep: Stored, leave blank to keep it
roku.noDevices: No Roku answered. A box must be awake and on this network.
roku.devModeHint: On the box, press with the remote: Home three times, Up twice, then Right, Left, Right, Left, Right. Enable the installer and choose a password.
roku.failedPassword: The box refused the developer password.
roku.pairHint: Once the channel opens on the box it shows a code. Approve it from a phone or browser signed in to this server, like any television.
roku.addressHint: For a network where the scan hears nothing: the box shows its address under Settings, Network, About.
roku.addFailed: Nothing at that address answered like a Roku.
